About.description: A Computer Science graduate from Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia with professional experience as a System Analyst and Web Developer. Skilled in business and technical requirements analysis, including the preparation of industry-standard documentation such as BRD and SRS. Experienced in system design using UML and ERD, and adept at collaborating with stakeholders and development teams to ensure seamless alignment between requirements and system implementation. Proficient in multiple programming languages including C, C++, Python, Java, and PHP, with a strong interest in software development, quality assurance, and game development.

description: Analyze business and technical requirements for the preparation of Business Requirement Document (BRD) and Software Requirements Specification (SRS) according to industry standards
Designing system modeling using UML diagrams and Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD) for database structures
Conduct intensive communication with the Project Owner, Project Manager, and developer team to synchronize system feature and functionality requirements
Ensure technical documentation is aligned with development progress
Designing relational database design and developing data input module via form and uploading Excel files
Develop interactive data visualization dashboards in the form of charts and regional mapping
Compile user guide documentation and perform Black Box Testing to ensure the quality of system functionality
Conduct material needs analysis and independently design game flow, storyboards, and game visual assets
Implement program code and compile technical documents (UML: Use Case, Activity, Sequence Diagram)
Conduct thorough Black Box Testing to ensure all game mechanics run as planned
Website Online Course (Individual): Fully responsible for designing the architecture and developing the main features of the website using the CodeIgniter 4 framework
Mosque Inventory Website (Team): Collaborate with the team in designing a SQL database and implementing data CRUD processes using the CodeIgniter 4 framework
Technical Documentation: Prepare technical documents for the mosque inventory project in accordance with university template standards to ensure readability of the system flow

list.title: Company Profile of PT. Mitra Graha Integrasi
list.description: Rebuilding PT. Mitra Graha Integrasi's company profile website with a more modern look and integration with a CMS system
list.detail: In this project, I am responsible for analyzing the company's business needs and designing and implementing new features on the website. I also create the technical documentation required for system development and maintenance.

list.title: Kopi Simulator
list.description: Marketing mix concept introduction game to fulfill thesis requirements in the form of a simple simulation game
list.detail: In this project, I am responsible for developing a simple simulation game to introduce the concept of the marketing mix. In the game, players will take on the role of a coffee entrepreneur trying to manage their business using the marketing mix concepts (4P). Players will face challenges and make decisions to develop their coffee business, such as determining pricing, product quality, location selection, and marketing strategies.

list.title: Academigod - Online Course Website
list.description: Developing a simple website for providing online course services as a final project for the Web Programming course
list.detail: In this project, I am responsible for developing a simple website that provides online course services. The website allows users to browse available courses, and register for courses. The website is built using the CodeIgniter 4 framework with PHP as the programming language and MySQL as the database management system.
